source_context_translations.translation: When he concentrates his breath and brings it to softness, can he become like an infant?
Can he cleanse and clear his dark inner vision so that it is without flaw?
Can he love the state and govern the people without employing knowledge?
Can he let Heaven’s gate open and shut and remain female?

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): To send something or someone to a place or person.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Neutral and common in literary prose.
Sentence Translations (English): The lord sent a letter to me.
The envoy delivered the order to Chu.
The cart brought grain to the army.
The official sent his son to school.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): To arrive at a state, standard, or result through effort or process.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Usually implies accomplishment or full realization, not mere approach.
Sentence Translations (English): Study and attain knowledge.
Excess labor brings on illness.
Long travel leads to fatigue.
Sincerity can earn trust.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): To cause a condition or result to come about, especially by acting so that something is produced or attained.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Often marks the successful outcome of sustained action or cultivation rather than simple motion toward a goal.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi text transmitted with Wang Bi commentary

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): Having little hardness, force, or rigidity; also used of a mild, yielding disposition or quality.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): In the Laozi, the word often carries the valued sense of yielding softness opposed to hardness or coercion.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi text transmitted with Wang Bi commentary

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): A very young child, especially one too young to speak or reason fully.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): In Laozi usage, it evokes unforced innocence and unselfconscious naturalness.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi text transmitted with Wang Bi commentary

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): To remove dirt or other matter by washing.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Concrete physical cleansing rather than moral or mental purification.
Sentence Translations (English): At dawn he washed away the dust and grime.
Use water to rinse the vessels clean.
Long rain can wash the mud off the steps.
First wash his clothes clean, and then use them.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): To wash away or remove what is unwanted, so that something becomes clean or clear.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): A deliberate removal of impediment or defilement, often with a strong sense of purification.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi text transmitted with Wang Bi commentary

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): A quiet, inward mode of viewing or contemplating that is not based on ordinary sense perception.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): In this passage it refers to inward, unobstructed understanding rather than visual inspection.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi text transmitted with Wang Bi commentary

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): A general imperfection or shortcoming in a thing, person, or plan.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Broader than a visible blemish; can refer to any failing or weakness.
Sentence Translations (English): If a vessel has a defect, it cannot be used.
Who has no faults?
Though the writing is good, it still has flaws.
His plan has only a small weakness.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): A mark, defect, or imperfection that mars something’s condition or appearance.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Usually a small defect, often with the sense of something that spoils otherwise good quality.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi text transmitted with Wang Bi commentary

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): To hold someone or something in affection, value, or tender regard.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Often implies valued regard that can include restraint and protective care, not only emotional warmth.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi text transmitted with Wang Bi commentary

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): A politically organized territory or realm under a ruler or government.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): In Warring States and Han literary usage, it can mean a feudal state, a realm, or a polity rather than a modern nation-state.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi text transmitted with Wang Bi commentary

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): A symbolic or cosmic gate associated with Heaven, the source or threshold of natural processes.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): In the Laozi, it is a metaphysical image for the origin or opening through which forces emerge and return.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi text transmitted with Wang Bi commentary

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): The act or process of opening and closing, especially viewed as a paired movement or cycle.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Used when the two motions are treated as a single process or pattern.
Sentence Translations (English): The opening and closing of a gate depend on the time.
Observe the opening and closing of yin and yang.
Its mechanism lies in opening and closing.
If opening and closing are regulated, affairs succeed.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): To open and close repeatedly or in alternation.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): The pair often suggests rhythmic alternation or the functioning of a threshold, not merely a single act of opening.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi text transmitted with Wang Bi commentary
contextual_sense.Translation (English): open and shut; open and close
